decisions.text: The team will proceed with the functional design phase.
The remote control should not include an LCD screen due to high cost and battery consumption.
The team will implement a beep sound feature to help locate the remote control.
The team will not implement speech recognition in the remote control as the technology is not mature and the market is not ready.
The team will use durable materials (e.g., harder plastic) to prevent symbols from fading.
The team will target younger people (under forty) with the new product.
The team will use the corporate colors (black and yellow) and keep the logo in mind.
The team will manufacture a basic remote control and sell changeable covers separately to appeal to everyone.
The team will make the remote control distinct from competitors (e.g., different shape or curves) to avoid confusion.
The team will focus on the user aspect (finding the remote, clear buttons, durability) rather than just technical aspects.

The power button should be on top because it is the first thing users do (turn it on).
The mute button should be placed around the volume selection, not at the top.
The channel buttons (up and down) should be on top.
The channel buttons should be grouped together in a specific section.
The channel button should be in the center of the remote.
The remote should have a beep and/or flash feature to help users find it if lost.
